import re, json, html as h
raw = open('/tmp/radar-20260926-0116.html').read()
now = 1790403388000  # ~06:16:28 UTC
end_win = now + 6*3600*1000
cards = re.findall(r'<article\b(.*?)</article>', raw, re.S)

    text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', h.unescape(text)).strip()
